Verity.Protocol.why: the protocol's definitions are trusted text: they import no assumption, guarantee or proof

Verity.Protocol.TC.Pipeline.why: the pipeline parameters both transcriptions read import nothing

Verity.Protocol.TC.Spec.why: the semantics (total.py, models.py, term.py) import no proofs and nothing of the relation

Verity.Protocol.TC.Relation.why: the relation (relation.py) imports no proofs and nothing of the semantics: the two transcriptions are independent

Verity.Assumptions.why: a named assumption reads the protocol's definitions, never a guarantee or a proof

Verity.Guarantees.why: a guarantee is stated over the protocol's definitions with named assumptions as hypotheses, never over a proof
